grade_reason: 4 P1 critical CVEs exceed C-grade threshold (max_p1=2). Security escalation required before next release.

p1_findings.title: vitest Arbitrary File Read & Execution
p1_findings.detail: Vitest UI server (≤3.2.5) allows remote attackers to read and execute arbitrary files when the UI is accessible on a network interface.
p1_findings.fix: npm install vitest@4.1.10 in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p1_findings.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
p1_findings.detail: protobufjs ≤7.6.4 allows arbitrary code execution via loading malicious .proto files — object properties can contain executable JavaScript.

p1_findings.title: handlebars JavaScript Injection in CLI Precompiler
p1_findings.detail: handlebars 4.0.0–4.7.8 allows JavaScript injection via unescaped template names and options in the CLI precompiler.
p1_findings.fix: Upgrade handlebars to ≥4.7.9 (run 'npm why handlebars' to find parent dep, then override or upgrade)

p1_findings.title: OpenTelemetry Prometheus Exporter Process Crash (DoS)
p1_findings.detail: @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node and @opentelemetry/sdk-node (≤0.218.0) crash on malformed HTTP request to Prometheus exporter — full process restart required.
p1_findings.fix: npm install @opentelemetry/sdk-node@0.221.0 (cascading OTel package updates required)

p2_findings.title: Stale dev-workflow-platform.md Pollutes Specifications/
p2_findings.detail: 74-FR spec for a different product (0% implemented) lives alongside the active spec, making any nominal coverage scan report catastrophic drift that does not exist.
p2_findings.fix: Move to docs/archive/ and update Specifications/README.md

p2_findings.title: Inspector Config Traceability Pattern Mismatches Codebase
p2_findings.detail: Pattern 'FR-\d+' never matches actual IDs (FR-WF-001, FR-dependency-*). Future inspector runs will report 0% coverage — a permanent false alarm.

p2_findings.title: GET /api/search Unimplemented — DependencyPicker UI Broken
p2_findings.detail: FR-dependency-search has full test contract in search.test.ts but the route is never registered. DependencyPicker.tsx search functionality is broken in production.
p2_findings.fix: Implement GET /api/search?q= route and register in app.ts

p2_findings.title: Route Handlers Call Store Directly — Service Layer Bypassed
p2_findings.detail: Three route files import * as store and call store functions directly, violating 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer'. Business logic in services is never invoked.
p2_findings.fix: Extract into workItemService.ts and have routes call that; pattern established by dependency.ts, router.ts, assessment.ts

p2_findings.title: Unbounded Pagination — Full Data Exfiltration via ?limit=999999
p2_findings.detail: GET /api/work-items accepts any limit value with no cap. Matches 'Unbounded list exfiltration' threat scenario in inspector.config.yml.
p2_findings.fix: Add const MAX_LIMIT = 100 and clamp: Math.min(pagination.limit || 20, MAX_LIMIT)

p2_findings.title: node_modules Not Installed — Verification Gates Cannot Run
p2_findings.detail: npm test fails with 'jest: not found'. CLAUDE.md required verification gates are unexecutable in this environment.
p2_findings.fix: Run npm install in Source/Backend/ and Source/Frontend/ as CI setup and agent bootstrap step

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion Denial of Service (All Projects)
p2_findings.fix: Update brace-expansion to ≥1.1.18 (usually via parent minimatch/glob upgrade)

p2_findings.title: react-router-dom XSS via unvalidated redirect
p2_findings.fix: npm install react-router-dom@7.18.2 (major version bump — test routing)

p2_findings.title: pino Path Traversal in Log Destinations
p2_findings.fix: npm install pino@10.3.1 (major version — check API compat)

p2_findings.title: nth-check ReDoS
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade parent css-select or svgo to pull in nth-check≥2.0.1

p2_findings.title: 4 Additional High CVEs (see dependency-audit-2026-08-16.md)
p2_findings.note: Full details in Teams/TheInspector/findings/dependency-audit-2026-08-16.md, DEP-014 through DEP-017

p2_findings.title: uuid 5 Major Versions Behind (9.0.1 → 14.0.1)
p2_findings.fix: npm install uuid@14.0.1 (breaking API changes expected — audit usage)

p2_findings.title: express 1 Major Version Behind (4.22.2 → 5.2.1)
p2_findings.fix: npm install express@5.2.1 (major — check middleware compat)
